description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and identifies that the OpenClaw theme changer skill is located at `~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/dashboard-theme/change-theme.sh`. 2. Agent resolves 'teal' to `#14b8a6` using the SKILL.md color name mapping table (or uses the hex directly as provided). 3. Agent invokes the script: `bash ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/dashboard-theme/change-theme.sh '#14b8a6'`. 4. The script dynamically locates the hashed CSS file (`index-a3f9c21b.css`) and JS bundle (`index-b7d4e89f.js`) under `~/.openclaw/ui/dist/assets/`. 5. The script replaces ALL CSS accent variables (`--accent`, `--accent-hover`, `--accent-muted`, `--accent-subtle`, `--accent-glow`, `--primary`, `--ring`, `--focus`) across ALL four theme blocks (:root, light, openknot, dash). 6. The old accent color `#e85d04` is fully eliminated from the CSS. 7. In the JS bundle, `#e85d04` is replaced with `#14b8a6` while the danger color `#ef4444` and standard palette colors (`#007bff`, `#00e5cc`, etc.) are preserved. 8. The key proprietary trap: an agent that tries to manually edit the CSS/JS files directly, or only updates one theme block, or forgets the JS bundle, or modifies the wrong files will fail. Only invoking `change-theme.sh` correctly triggers the full multi-variable, multi-theme, multi-file replacement logic described in SKILL.md.
